This safety gate is the easiest and most discrete way to protect your pets all around the house. It's recommended for small pets and it can be moved from one place to another if needed. When not in use, the gate takes minimal space and blends perfectly with your home and decor with its simple and effective design.

It is pressure-mounted with rubber bumpers so it doesn't damage the walls, and it provides a secure and custom fit in your house. This safety net gate is perfect for doorways, between walls, and stairwells.

The unique woven barrier can easily retract to a fully or partially quick pass-through. It can be assembled immediately without any tools.

It is built with tough partially see-through woven mesh fabric woven to withstand abuse from pets.

Lightweight and portable to meet all your on-the-go needs.

Product Specifications:
Color： Black

Material: Nylon mesh + stainless steel tube

Size:
S： 43’‘X29’‘
M：70.9"X28.3"

How to Use:
Unfold the fabric woven

Stretch two metal poles to the max length

Put these two poles into the tunnels on both sides

Fix the sticky hooks where you will install this magic gate

Hang the fabric woven on the four hooks

Package Include:
1 X mesh gate
